commentary.bulkers: The Kamsarmax "Montana I" 81/2011 Daewoo, Korea (SS/DD 12/2025) was committed to European interests at USD 15,4 mill. For comparison, the "Silver Navigator" 82/2011 Stx, Korea (SS/DD 07/2026) was sold a month ago at USD 15,5 mill. Sea Trade Marine committed their Panamax "Atheras" 74/2006 Hudong- Zhonghua, China (SS 09/2026, DD 10/2025) & "Porto Limnioni" 73/2006 Jiangnan, China (SS/DD 06/2026) to undisclosed interests at USD 8,5 mill each. For reference, the two-years-older "Protefs" 73/2004 Jiangnan, China (SS 06/2027, DD 07/2025) was sold back in June at USD 7 mill. On the Supramax sector, Shih Wei Navigation committed their "Forever SW" 58/2010 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS 05/2030, DD 04/2028) at USD 15,2 mill. Note that a month ago, the sister vessel "Doric Victory" 58/2010 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS 05/2030, DD 05/2028) was sold at USD 15 mill. Moreover, the "Haut Brion" 57/2011 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 12/2026) was committed to Chinese interests at USD 12,3 mill, while the sister vessel "Ocean Knight" 56/2011 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 01/2026) was sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 12 mill. Eurotankers have committed their Handysize "Eurosky" 33/2011 Samjin, China (SS/DD 08/2026) at USD 10,3 mill. For reference, the sister vessel "Birte Selmer" 34/2011 Samjin, China (SS/DD 06/2026) was sold back in June at USD 9,9 mill.
commentary.tankers: The VLCC "Dalma" 306/2007 Daewoo, Korea (SS/DD 02/2027) of CMB.Tech was committed to Chinese interests at rgn USD 48,5 mill. Note that back in August, the one-year-younger "Maran Capricorn" 320/2008 Daewoo, Korea (SS 06/2028, DD 04/2026, Scrubber fitted) was sold at USD 52,5 mill. Karatas M committed the Suezmax "Konya" 163/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 05/2030, DD 07/2028) to undisclosed interests at USD 28,4 mill. Remind you that a month ago, the "Kriti Vigor" 159/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 02/2030, DD 02/2028, Scrubber fitted) was sold at USD 29 mill. Toro Corp have acquired the MR2 "Green Sky" 50/2014 Dae Sun, Korea (SS 06/2029, DD 07/2027) from Aegean Shipping Management at a price of USD 30,3 mill. For reference, the "STI Regina" 50/2014 Spp, Korea (SS 09/2029, DD 09/2027, Scrubber fitted) was sold back in May at USD 31 mill.
